author: Arbitra
rationale: Reading beyond a unit is the largest cost of a run: on nananananana half of Opus's units spent all 8 tool turns, at 98,000 tokens a turn by the last, and 951 of 1,510 searches were a bare name with a read to follow. Units now look names up, several at once, take a search's context with its hits, ask for all they can name in one turn, and are told the turns they have left.
compatibilityNotes: a run pinned at 2.0.0 resumes and replays as it was: it keeps its tools, its prompt and its tool turns
